result.question: Qual o nível de instrução dos pacientes internados?
result.gold_sql: SELECT ins."DESCRICAO", COUNT(*) AS total FROM internacoes i JOIN instrucao ins ON i."INSTRU" = ins."INSTRU" WHERE i."INSTRU" IS NOT NULL AND i."INSTRU" != 0 GROUP BY ins."INSTRU", ins."DESCRICAO" ORDER BY total DESC;
